01 / A LITTLE ABOUT ME

A field mindset.
A builder’s curiosity.

I work where technology meets the real world. My background started in network technology at Ovation Networks, and today I work as a fiber technician at Forged Fiber, installing fiber for AT&T.

Outside of the field, I’m building Fitness Vault, a fitness dashboard and app, and the website for my business, ARTHEON. This is where I share that work as it takes shape.
